_readme: name: [lat, lon, level, display]. level 3 = city/county, 2 = state/province, 1 = country/region. Matching is case sensitive on whole words. Two-letter state codes only match after a comma, e.g. 'Abilene, TX'. Add places freely. County, Parish and Township keys hold one entry or a list of candidates (one per state, Census county centroids from us-atlas); the fetcher picks the candidate whose state matches other places in the story or the outlet's state, and skips the name when it stays ambiguous.
